messages:
Lydia (AE): FYI - Quantis CTO just pushed this to execs. They want a written plan for the POC blockers + a short exec call this week. Big asks: 1) steady 95th percentile latency <150ms for 2k concurrent sessions, 2) data residency EU-only, 3) committed pricing proposal for Dedicated nodes.
Marco (SE): copying logs from last run attached, throughput drops at ~1.6k concurrent sessions. Likely token-burst GC on the host.
Priya (SE): not seeing GC in the app logs, but we do see KV cache thrash. Can reproduce locally with customer seed.
Lydia (AE): CTO is insistent on a canary SLA before signing. Wants to see root-cause and remediation steps by Thu EOD.
Marco (SE): quick checks: model variant was rwd-7b-quant (q4), instance type gpu-a100-40GB, API batch_size=8. I can try increasing cache TTL and pinning sessions.
Priya (SE): proposed config diff:
```
- cache_ttl: 60s
+ cache_ttl: 300s
- batch_size: 8
+ batch_size: 4
- enable_prefetch: false
+ enable_prefetch: true
```
Marco (SE): will run an A/B tonight and post perf numbers.
Nora (PM): also need to surface fallbacks for degraded capacity (model routing -> rwd-3b-quant) and expected quality delta to the customer. I can draft a short note.
Lydia (AE): Pricing ask: customer wants committed monthly spend for Dedicated with an escape clause after 90 days if SLOs not met. Any guidance on standard language?
Raj (VP Sales): we can offer 6-month reserved with a performance SLA and a 3-month ramp credit. Legal needs to approve the escape clause.
Elena (Legal): provide draft terms and specific metrics for SLA (p99 latency, error rate). We need measurable instrumentation feeds for audit.
cindy-deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-09-03T02:33Z: canary run queued on cluster-7 (tag: quantis-poc).
Marco (SE): Canary run kicked off. Baseline run attached: 95th=210ms, p99=420ms at peak 1.6k. I'll push cache changes and re-run.
Lydia (AE): CTO asked for an executive briefing call with Raj + CTO + Head of Infra on Fri 09:00 UTC. Is that doable?
Raj (VP Sales): I can do Fri 09:00 UTC. Nora, can you prepare two slides: 1) POC status + blockers, 2) mitigation plan + timeline + commercial proposal.
Nora (PM): on it. Draft will be in the thread by Thu noon.
Priya (SE): quick note — data residency: Private deployment in eu-west-1 is already enabled, but they want customer-managed KMS. We need to confirm HSM/KMS integration feasibility with infra team.
Elena (Legal): also confirm data sub-processing terms and SOC2 export controls.
Marco (SE): Canary re-run results (1898765520): 95th=140ms, p99=230ms after cache_ttl=300s and batch_size=4. Throughput stable at 2k with slight quality drop on long contexts.
Lydia (AE): that's promising. CTO will want numbers in a table and a short explanation of quality vs cost tradeoffs.
Raj (VP Sales): pricing draft: committed monthly for dedicated cluster (4xA100-40) at $XXk/month with a 20% ramp credit for first 3 months. Include optional 10% discount for 12-month commit. Add SLA penalty credits for missed p99.
Elena (Legal): send me the exact SLA metric definitions and the telemetry endpoints we will use.
Nora (PM): attaching proposed rollout plan:
- Thu: finalize config + run final canary (2k sessions)
- Fri: exec briefing 09:00 UTC (Raj + Lydia + CTO + Head Infra)
- Mon: production canary with customer traffic mirror (24h)
- After successful canary: signature & provisioning
Lydia (AE): customer asked for a single page summary for their CFO showing monthly TCO vs current provider. Can marketing help?
Raj (VP Sales): marketing can spin up a one-pager. Lydia, I'll loop in marketing if you share the t-shirt numbers.
Lydia (AE): will share numbers in DM.
Priya (SE): follow-up technical note: when we route to rwd-3b-quant fallback, latency improves but hallucination rate on entity extraction goes up ~6%. Documenting for the execs.
Marco (SE): leaving a short runbook snippet to reproduce the cache fix:
```bash
# increase cache ttl and reduce batch size for steady latency
curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/configs/update -d '{"cache_ttl":300, "batch_size":4}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Lydia (AE): OK — next actions: Marco final canary + logs, Nora slides, Raj pricing paragraph, Elena legal checklist, Priya KMS feasibility. Everyone, please update by Thu 18:00 UTC so we can prep for Fri briefing. :thumbsup:
Raj (VP Sales): Agreed. I'll be on the Fri call.
Nora (PM): I'll ping for slide review Thu 12:30 UTC.
Elena (Legal): I'll route DPA checklist by Thu 17:00 UTC.
Marco (SE): final canary results to be posted by Thu 16:00 UTC.
Priya (SE): checking KMS with infra now.
Lydia (AE): thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
